response.overview: In a province like South Tyrol, it sometimes seems as if there is no room for change. Yet, 2025 marked a milestone: the first Südtirolo Pride. A look at this historic event, centering the voices of the activists and support networks championing the LGBTQIA+ community in the region. Mapping the journey from struggles to the vibrant celebration, this film stands as a moving testament that every stride toward equity truly matters.
response.title: We Are Here
